caption: The drawing depicts six metallic objects arranged in two vertical columns against a plain, off-white background. The left column contains three U-shaped clips, each positioned diagonally with the open end facing toward the lower right. The top U-clip is colored grey with shading that suggests a smooth, steel surface. The middle U-clip is brownish, indicating a rusted or aged metal appearance. The bottom U-clip appears darker brown with patches of green, suggesting more significant oxidation and corrosion. Corresponding to each U-clip, the right column contains three split rings, each resembling a keyring. The top ring is shiny and grey, with highlights and shadows that give it a metallic, polished appearance. The middle ring has a dark greenish-brown hue, indicating tarnish or patina. The bottom ring is even darker, with a mix of brown, green, and black colors, further suggesting corrosion or oxidation. Each U-clip visually aligns horizontally with its respective split ring, and there is a small colored legend with sample color swatches and text at the bottom center of the drawing.
title: Color Notes on Iron
